degradedReasons.llmNotConfigured: No model configured — listening and scheduling still run, but drafts are placeholder text rather than model output. Configure one under Settings → Model to get real drafts.
degradedReasons.agentMissing: The conversation agent is unavailable — drafts now come straight from the model, with no tool calls and no fact retrieval, so quality drops noticeably. Your model config is fine; don't change it. In development, run `pnpm prepare:bin`.
degradedReasons.agentUnreadable: Could not read the conversation agent's version — degraded to direct model generation (no tools, no retrieval). This is not a model problem, so leave the model config alone. Usually the binary was never prepared or the OS blocked it: run `pnpm prepare:bin`, which now executes it once and reports why it failed.
degradedReasons.agentTooOld: The conversation agent is too old — degraded to direct model generation (no tools, no retrieval). Run `pnpm install && pnpm prepare:bin` to get the pinned version.

killSwitchOn: Global stop is on: every automatic send is blocked (drafts are still produced).
tickHint: Run one scheduling pass without waiting for the timer
killSwitchHint: Immediately stops every automatic send. Survives restarts.
pickConversation: Pick a conversation on the left
autoWarn: Low-risk replies go out as you; anything the gate says is your call is downgraded to a draft for review.
sentByPersonaApproved: drafted by persona · approved by me
sendBoundary: "Send" really sends as you. It is blocked while the kill switch is on.
activityDescription: Auto-sent replies and drafts you approved
activityEmpty: No replies have been sent in this conversation
activityEmptyHint: Auto-sent replies and drafts you approve will appear here.

reasons.mode_not_auto: Draft-only mode — your own choice, not a block
reasons.outside_work_hours: Outside the work hours you set
reasons.scene_disallows_auto: This draft isn't suitable for auto-send (a question / a commitment / too long / not @-mentioned in a group)
reasons.agent_requires_review: The agent decided this reply needs your confirmation, so it was downgraded to review
reasons.low_confidence: Reply confidence too low (we deliberately don't self-evaluate, so this rarely appears)
reasons.banned_phrase: The draft hit one of your banned phrases
reasons.rate_limited: Too many sends in a short window — cooling off
reasons.grant_missing: This conversation has no send authorization yet
reasons.dry_run: Dry run: policy isn't evaluated and nothing is sent
reasons.already_answered: You already replied to this turn yourself, so it wasn't auto-sent. The draft is kept — edit and send it if you still want to.

drops.self_conversation: Conversation with yourself — excluded from the reply queue
drops.already_answered: A later reply from you already closed this turn
drops.stale_message: Message was read and left unanswered for over 4 hours
drops.batch_overflow: Too many messages in one turn; only the newest batch was kept
drops.origin_agent: Sent by the persona itself; it won't trigger on its own messages
drops.is_self: You sent it — no reply needed
drops.trigger_not_matched: Trigger not matched (e.g. set to "when @-mentioned" but no mention)

emptyThreadHint: Messages appear here after a sync

noDraftsHint: Drafts appear here when a new message arrives and the gate says it is your call; or hit "Run now" above
citationsHint: Scroll to and highlight the messages it cited

pendingBadgeHint: Messages not yet processed, waiting for the next tick
unreadBadgeHint: Messages you haven't read (DingTalk's red dot). Different from "pending" — that one means the persona hasn't run yet.
quotedOutOfRange: (that message is outside the synced range)

sendReasonRateLimited: Send rate limit reached, try again later
sendReasonKillSwitch: The global kill switch is on
runStateRunningHint: Running normally: drafts or auto-sends per each conversation's settings.
railNoAuto: No conversation uses auto-send yet — set the reply mode to Auto in conversation settings.

dockComposePlaceholder: Write one yourself, sent as you…
